title: "scVI_RNA_GeneScore"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-29"

Single-modality and multimodal gene scores for Fig. 1c. All three models are scVI and use **the same two input matrices**:

* **RNA:** raw RNA counts of all 33,258 genes.
* **ATAC:** ArchR gene scores rounded to integers. They are pseudo-counts, scaled to 10,000 per cell by ArchR. The matrix is aligned to the same 33,258 genes; genes without an ArchR gene score (not in the ArchR gene annotation) are set to 0.

# Setup

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(reticulate)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
use_condaenv("multivi", conda = "C:/Users/chang/miniconda3_2/Scripts/conda.exe")

scvi <- import("scvi", convert = FALSE)
ad   <- import("anndata", convert = FALSE)
sp   <- import("scipy.sparse", convert = FALSE)
pd   <- import("pandas", convert = FALSE)

scvi$settings$seed <- 0L   # scvi-tools seed (R's set.seed does not reach Python)
py_config()
```

```{r}
data_dir <- "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/Data/"
out_dir  <- "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/MultiVI/scVI_RNA_GeneScore/"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

PID.use      <- c(9, 12)
celltype_col <- "predicted.celltype.l1"
N_TOP        <- 10000
LIKELIHOOD   <- "nb"
MAX_EPOCHS   <- NULL   # NULL = scvi-tools default, as in the tutorials

NK_panel <- c(
  "CD57", "CD14", "CD25", "CD8", "CCR7", "PD1", "CD7", "TIM-3", "NKG2D", "TIGIT",
  "NKG2C", "CD27", "NKp30", "CXCR6", "CD45RO", "CD69", "CD49a", "CXCR5", "CD127",
  "KIR2DL1", "KIR3DL1", "DNAM-1", "NKG2A", "CD3", "CD38", "CD4", "CD56",
  "HLA-DR", "CD16", "IFITM1", "IFIT1", "AIM2", "IFIT3", "SLFN11", "MX2", "pIRF3",
  "MX1", "RIGI", "BRD4", "OAS1"
)
NK_signal  <- c("PTPRC", "HLA-DMB", "HLA-DMA", "HLA-DPB1", "HLA-G")
CD8_signal <- c("SLFN11", "AIM2", "CCR7", "IFITM1", "CD7", "MX1", "TIGIT", "MX2", "CD38", "IFIT3",
                "CXCR5", "BRD4", "CD14", "CD69", "MAPK14", "HNRNPD", "HNRNPH1", "YBX1", "FOS",
```

# Loading data with Seurat

The object holds the RNA counts (assay `RNA`) and the ArchR gene scores (assay `ATAC`) of the same cells.

```{r}
Data.input <- readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "Seurat_RNA_ATAC_CD8_NK.rds"))
table(PID = Data.input$PID, cell_type = Data.input@meta.data[[celltype_col]])
```

# Input matrices (identical for the three models)

```{r}
# RNA: raw counts, all genes (genes x cells)
rna_matrix <- function(seurat) {
  GetAssayData(seurat, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
}

# ATAC: ArchR gene scores rounded to integer pseudo-counts, aligned to the RNA genes (missing genes = 0)
atac_matrix <- function(seurat, genes) {
  gs <- GetAssayData(seurat, assay = "ATAC", layer = "data")
  gs <- as(gs, "CsparseMatrix")
  gs@x <- round(gs@x)
  gs <- drop0(gs)
  shared  <- intersect(genes, rownames(gs))
  missing <- setdiff(genes, rownames(gs))
  empty   <- Matrix(0, nrow = length(missing), ncol = ncol(gs), sparse = TRUE,
                    dimnames = list(missing, colnames(gs)))
  rbind(gs[shared, , drop = FALSE], empty)[genes, ]
}
```

# Converting to AnnData

```{r}
# mat: genes x cells; obs_df: data.frame with one row per cell (rownames = cell names)
to_anndata <- function(mat, obs_df) {
  X   <- sp$csr_matrix(r_to_py(as(Matrix::t(mat), "CsparseMatrix")))$astype("float32")
  obs <- pd$DataFrame(r_to_py(lapply(obs_df, as.character)), index = rownames(obs_df))
  var <- pd$DataFrame(index = rownames(mat))
  ad$AnnData(X = X, obs = obs, var = var)
}
```

# Setup, training and differential expression


```{r}
run_scvi <- function(adata, model_dir, batch_key = NULL) {
  if (is.null(batch_key)) {
    scvi$model$SCVI$setup_anndata(adata)
    model <- scvi$model$SCVI(adata, gene_likelihood = LIKELIHOOD)
  } else {
    scvi$model$SCVI$setup_anndata(adata, batch_key = batch_key)
    model <- scvi$model$SCVI(adata, gene_likelihood = LIKELIHOOD, dispersion = "gene-batch")
  }
  if (is.null(MAX_EPOCHS)) model$train() else model$train(max_epochs = as.integer(MAX_EPOCHS))
  model$save(model_dir, overwrite = TRUE)

  latent <- py_to_r(model$get_latent_representation())
  rownames(latent) <- py_to_r(adata$obs_names$tolist())

  # NK vs CD8 T: scale1 = mean normalized expression in NK, scale2 = in CD8 T
  DE <- model$differential_expression(adata, groupby = "cell_type", group1 = "NK", group2 = "CD8 T")
  de <- as.data.frame(py_to_r(DE$reset_index()$to_dict(orient = "list")))
  names(de)[1] <- "gene"

  list(de = de, latent = latent,
       n_epochs = length(py_to_r(model$history[["elbo_train"]]$index$tolist())))
}
```


```{r}
res.list <- list()

for (pid in PID.use) {
  seurat <- subset(Data.input, subset = PID == pid)
  cells  <- colnames(seurat)
  meta   <- data.frame(cell_type = seurat@meta.data[[celltype_col]], PID = pid, row.names = cells)

  rna  <- rna_matrix(seurat)
  atac <- atac_matrix(seurat, rownames(rna))
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(rna), rownames(atac)), identical(colnames(rna), colnames(atac)))
  message("PID ", pid, ": ", nrow(rna), " genes, ", ncol(rna), " cells; ",
          sum(Matrix::rowSums(atac) > 0), " genes with ATAC signal")

  base <- paste0(path.expand(out_dir), "PID", pid, "_")

  # single modality
  res_rna  <- run_scvi(to_anndata(rna,  meta), paste0(base, "scVI_RNA"))
  res_atac <- run_scvi(to_anndata(atac, meta), paste0(base, "scVI_ATAC"))

  # multimodal: same two matrices stacked by cell, modality as batch
  meta_both <- rbind(
    data.frame(meta, modality = "RNA",  row.names = paste0(cells, "_RNA")),
    data.frame(meta, modality = "ATAC", row.names = paste0(cells, "_ATAC"))
  )
  both <- cbind(rna, atac)
  colnames(both) <- rownames(meta_both)
  res_both <- run_scvi(to_anndata(both, meta_both), paste0(base, "scVI_multimodal"),
                       batch_key = "modality")

  res.list[[as.character(pid)]] <- list(RNA = res_rna, ATAC = res_atac, Multimodal = res_both,
                                        meta = meta, meta_both = meta_both)
}

saveRDS(res.list, file = paste0(out_dir, "scVI_RNA_GeneScore_PID_9_12.rds"))

# genes and epochs per model
do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res.list), function(p) do.call(rbind, lapply(c("RNA", "ATAC", "Multimodal"), function(m)
  data.frame(PID = p, model = m, n_genes = nrow(res.list[[p]][[m]]$de),
             n_epochs = res.list[[p]][[m]]$n_epochs)))))
```

# Gene rankings (all 33,258 genes)

```{r}
rank_desc <- function(x) rank(-x, ties.method = "first", na.last = "keep")

df.list <- list()
for (pid in PID.use) {
  r <- res.list[[as.character(pid)]]

  for (ct in c("NK", "CD8_T")) {
    score_col <- if (ct == "NK") "scale1" else "scale2"   # group1 = NK, group2 = CD8 T
    goi       <- if (ct == "NK") c(NK_panel, NK_signal) else CD8_signal

    scores <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "gene", all = TRUE), list(
      data.frame(gene = r$RNA$de$gene,        score_rna      = r$RNA$de[[score_col]]),
      data.frame(gene = r$ATAC$de$gene,       score_atac     = r$ATAC$de[[score_col]]),
      data.frame(gene = r$Multimodal$de$gene, score_combined = r$Multimodal$de[[score_col]])
    ))
    scores$rank_rna      <- rank_desc(scores$score_rna)
    scores$rank_atac     <- rank_desc(scores$score_atac)
    scores$rank_combined <- rank_desc(scores$score_combined)
    scores <- scores[order(scores$rank_combined), ]

    # full rankings, and top-N genes (multimodal score) for Incytr
    write.csv(scores, paste0(out_dir, "scVI_gene_scores_PID", pid, "_", ct, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(head(scores[, c("gene", "rank_combined", "score_combined")], N_TOP),
              paste0(out_dir, "scVI_top", N_TOP, "_PID", pid, "_", ct, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    comparison <- data.frame(
      gene          = goi,
      rank_rna      = scores$rank_rna[match(goi, scores$gene)],
      rank_atac     = scores$rank_atac[match(goi, scores$gene)],
      rank_combined = scores$rank_combined[match(goi, scores$gene)],
      cell_type     = ct,
      PID           = pid
    )
    df.list[[paste(pid, ct)]] <- comparison[order(comparison$rank_combined), ]
  }
}

comparison_all <- rbindlist(df.list)
write.csv(comparison_all, file = paste0(out_dir, "scVI_3score_comparison.csv"))

comparison_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% c("CD4", "MX1", "MX2", "IFIT3", "SLFN11", "IFITM1", "BRD4", "AIM2",
                            "PTPRC", "HLA-DMB", "HLA-DMA", "HLA-DPB1", "HLA-G"))
```

# Getting the latent representation and visualization (QC)

This is a sanity check, as in the tutorials. In the single-modality models, NK and CD8 T should separate. In the multimodal model, RNA and ATAC profiles of the same cell type should overlap.

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 12}
plots <- list()
for (pid in PID.use) {
  r <- res.list[[as.character(pid)]]
  for (m in c("RNA", "ATAC", "Multimodal")) {
    meta_m <- if (m == "Multimodal") r$meta_both else r$meta
    latent <- r[[m]]$latent[rownames(meta_m), ]
    so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = nrow(meta_m), sparse = TRUE,
                                             dimnames = list(c("g1", "g2"), rownames(meta_m))),
                             meta.data = meta_m)
    so[["scvi"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = latent, key = "scvi_", assay = "RNA")
    so <- RunUMAP(so, reduction = "scvi", dims = 1:ncol(latent), verbose = FALSE)
    plots[[paste(pid, m)]] <- DimPlot(so, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type",
                                      shape.by = if (m == "Multimodal") "modality" else NULL) +
      ggplot2::ggtitle(paste0("PID ", pid, " - scVI ", m))
  }
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)
```
